general.session_name:
- null for an automatic format like 'version_parameters'
- or type wanted-name for folder
general.search_data:
- true to make automatic query with Obspy
- false for data in 'Data' folder
- or dir to the folder with data
general.keep_data:
- 'all' to keep all data
- 'used' for only used signals
- null (default) remove all data for minimum space
general.saved_results:
- 'all' to save everything in files
- 'plot' to redo plots later
- 'detailed' saves all stations contribution over time
- 'minimum' for files with general results, station contribution and energy growth
- 'fastest' only write in the general results file
general.do_plot:
- 'format' (.png,.pdf, etc...) for wanted figures
- null for no figures
general.do_report:
- true to put everything in a pdf file (will overwrite other option to minimum report level)
- false if no pdf file wanted

plot.level:
- 'minimum' : energy growth and raw traces
- 'report' : 'minimum' level + map of stations deviation + results in a graphic text
- 'all' : output every possible plots
- 'personalized' : select following parameters with true or false

details.results: graphic text of the results (energy, energy magnitude, slowness, in BroadBand and HighFrequencies
details.signal: raw data ploted along azimuth and arrival time and colored by distance
details.signal_stack: superposed raw data against relative arrival time and colored by distance
details.postsignal_stack: superposed data after correction for amplifications
details.spectrum: spectrum of corrected data used for energy estimations colored by azimuthal angle
details.growth: energy growth in BroadBand and HighFrequencies band + rupture time estimation
details.station_dev: deviation of the stations + threshold of correction
details.map_sta_dev: map of the stations and respective deviation
details.stream_list: write a list of all the data references

time_max:
- int for maximum time
- null will set a value based on magnitude
time_stop:
- true for an automatic time stop
- false will run the full time_max window
time_eval_method:
- 'tacer' for the time-averaged cumulative energy rate
- 'trend' for start and end trend lines
- 'both' for a joint method

distance_max.step:
- int in degree to request data with an increseasing range (by value) over time
- or null to make one general data request

channel_code:
list of desired data channels among [BH,SH,HH]
- https://ds.iris.edu/ds/nodes/dmc/data/formats/seed-channel-naming/

deviation_correction.type:
- 'station' to correct known station with deviaiton
- 'result' to remove deviatoric stations after energy estimation on this event ONLY
deviation_correction.threshold: float accepted for the deviation (in log10 of the energy)

redoing_results.force_results:
bool to redo the estimation if the results already exists
- doesn't overwrite in the general results file
- if no data are saved, will perform the query
redoing_results.force_signal:
bool to research data again if they already exists
- false by default if 'keep-data' is false
redoing_results.force_plot:
bool to redo the plots if they already exists
- if results are saved, only do the plots
- if no results exists and no data are saved, do all the those steps
